page_title: HOF 3-3 DAR | Hoffenheim v Darmstadt 19/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+7' A dangerous towering header by Pavel Kaderabek (Hoffenheim) from around the penalty spot goes just wide of the left post. This corner kick didn't change the score.
90+6' Robert Skov (Hoffenheim) will take the corner.
90+6' Julian Justvan (Hoffenheim) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. Hoffenheim have a corner.
90+6' Finn Ole Becker (Hoffenheim) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. It's a throw-in for Hoffenheim.
90+3' Robert Skov (Hoffenheim) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.

90+2' Anton Stach (Hoffenheim) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. Hoffenheim have been awarded a corner kick.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
90' Robert Skov (Hoffenheim) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
90' Pellegrino Matarazzo decides to make a substitution. Ozan Kabak will be replaced by Julian Justvan (Hoffenheim).
90' It is time for a substitution. Finn Ole Becker (Hoffenheim) is on for Grischa Promel.
88' The current number of shots on goal is 4:3.
87' The resulting corner from Robert Skov (Hoffenheim) is cleared by the opposition's defence.

85' 3 - 3 Brilliant finish! Tim Skarke (Darmstadt) perfectly collected a pass on the edge of the penalty area from Luca Pfeiffer, then produced a nice strike into the bottom right corner. The score is 3:3.
84' Torsten Lieberknecht prepares a substitution. Matthias Bader is replaced by Mathias Honsak (Darmstadt).
84' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Tobias Kempe departs the field of play to be replaced by Fabio Torsiello (Darmstadt).
81' Clemens Riedel (Darmstadt) has tested the patience of referee Frank Willenborg and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
80' John Anthony Brooks (Hoffenheim) receives a fine cross inside the box and attempts to score a goal, but his strike flies just a few inches over the bar.
80' Robert Skov (Hoffenheim) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
80' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Maximilian Beier (Hoffenheim), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Hoffenheim.
76' Robert Skov (Hoffenheim) comes close as his long-range free kick goes a whisker wide of the right post.
75' Frank Willenborg shows a yellow card to Tim Skarke (Darmstadt) for his blatant foul.
75' Substitution. Thomas Poppler Isherwood did his best and is replaced by Matej Maglica (Darmstadt).
75' Problems for Torsten Lieberknecht as Bartol Franjic (Darmstadt) is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Andreas Muller replaces him.
74' The game is interrupted now, Bartol Franjic (Darmstadt) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
73' That will be all from Andrej Kramaric who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Maximilian Beier (Hoffenheim).
72' Ihlas Bebou (Hoffenheim) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Frank Willenborg had an easy-decision to make.
70' Tobias Kempe (Darmstadt) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
69' Tobias Kempe (Darmstadt) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger. Darmstadt earn a corner.

66' 3 - 2 Goal! Florian Grillitsch puts Ihlas Bebou (Hoffenheim) in the clear with just the keeper to beat. He takes his shot early from the edge of the box and scores beautifully into the bottom right corner. 3:2.
65' Close! Robert Skov (Hoffenheim) takes the resulting free kick from a promising positon, but his effort flies inches wide of the right post.
65' Robert Skov (Hoffenheim) will take the free kick.
65' Frank Willenborg blows the whistle, Tim Skarke (Darmstadt) is penalised for a foul. Hoffenheim win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
64' Bartol Franjic (Darmstadt) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
63' Bartol Franjic (Darmstadt) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
61' The corner by Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) lacks accuracy as it's hit with too much power.

60' Pavel Kaderabek (Hoffenheim) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Hoffenheim.
59' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Luca Pfeiffer (Darmstadt) was quite harsh and Frank Willenborg didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

57' 2 - 2 Goal! Luca Pfeiffer finds Tim Skarke (Darmstadt) with a clever pass. He steps inside his man on the edge of the box and whips a tremendous shot into the bottom right corner. Fantasy football! 2:2.
55' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.

55' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger. The ball is out of play and Hoffenheim manage to earn a corner.
54' We are about to witness a substitution. Florian Grillitsch (Hoffenheim) is replacing Umut Tohumcu.
52' Anton Stach (Hoffenheim) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
51' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) races through the centre to the edge of the box then lets fly with a rocket of a shot that flies just over the bar.
50' Tobias Kempe (Darmstadt) steps up to take a free kick and sends it in, but the opposition's defence is alert and clears the ball to safety.
49' Robert Skov (Hoffenheim) is shown a yellow card by the referee.
49' Darmstadt hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Marius Bulter (Hoffenheim) is replaced by Robert Skov.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Torsten Lieberknecht gives a chance to Frank Ronstadt and Klaus Gjasula (Darmstadt) is off.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' Frank Willenborg has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+2' Ihlas Bebou (Hoffenheim) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
45' A dangerous towering header by John Anthony Brooks (Hoffenheim) from around the penalty spot goes just over the bar. This corner kick didn't change the score.
44' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) takes the corner.

44' Ihlas Bebou (Hoffenheim) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Ihlas Bebou (Hoffenheim) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Hoffenheim have been awarded a corner kick.
40' Some great controlled play and passing from Darmstadt. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
38' The ball is cleared after Grischa Promel (Hoffenheim) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Darmstadt.
36' Tobias Kempe (Darmstadt) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
35' Bartol Franjic (Darmstadt) tries a pot shot from the edge of the box, but it goes narrowly wide of the left post.
33' Tobias Kempe (Darmstadt) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
32' Luca Pfeiffer (Darmstadt) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
28' 2 - 1 Ihlas Bebou (Hoffenheim) beats the offside trap and bears down on goal. With just the keeper to beat he coolly shoots past him from the edge of the box.
28' Tobias Kempe (Darmstadt) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.

28' Bartol Franjic (Darmstadt) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety. Good work from Darmstadt as they win a corner.
24' Big chance! A simple pass from Pavel Kaderabek left Grischa Promel (Hoffenheim) with just the keeper to beat inside the box, but his shot went agonisingly just past the left post.
23' 1 - 1 Goal! Bartol Franjic plays a pass to the feet of Luca Pfeiffer (Darmstadt), and he shoots inside the right post from inside the box. It's 1:1.
19' Emir Karic (Darmstadt) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
14' 1 - 0 Goal! Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) puts the ball into the bottom right corner past the outstretched arm of Marcel Schuhen.
14' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
13' Klaus Gjasula (Darmstadt) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.

13' Klaus Gjasula (Darmstadt) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Frank Willenborg blows his whistle for an infringement. PENALTY! Wonderful opportunity to score for Hoffenheim.
10' Darmstadt are ruled offside.

9' What a chance! Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) squanders a promising opportunity as he latches on to a perfect cross from the wing. He produces a bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes just wide of the right post!
5' John Anthony Brooks (Hoffenheim) tries to find Marius Bulter, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
3' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
3' Pavel Kaderabek (Hoffenheim) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. Now Hoffenheim have a corner.
1' The first half has started.
The players are on the pitch and Hoffenheim will have the kick-off.
Frank Willenborg is introduced as the referee for today's match.
